role: New isolated native cached-merit coupled bound and norm-free fixed-sweep proposal; classical identities, ordinary floating point, no priority claim.

api.proposal: fixed_sweep_missing_fields(expected_oracle,snapshot,normfree_contexts,sweeps=0,initial=None) -> readonly per-frequency Lambda/V fields and query-cost receipt. Initialization is coarse Galerkin if absent.
api.bound: evaluate_cached_merit(expected_oracle,snapshot,missing_fields,stability_contexts,direction=None) -> CachedMeritCertificate. Direction defaults to unit negative SUM of all physical frequency/source contributions; an explicit real shared direction is supported.
api.owner_admission: Calls expected_oracle.validate_merit_fields(snapshot) first. Native oracle owns issued-type/identity registry, immutable byte manifests, current/receipt/operator/model/geometry/data checks. No factor handles/private receipt reads occur in evaluator.
api.binding: Result includes full safe native snapshot.to_dict manifest: model/operator/geometry/data/receipt hashes, field/receiver/data hashes, configuration, accuracy scope. Controlled synthetic issuers are only used to stress mathematical paid-field errors in tests.

proof: Retain measured residuals of paid U or Z=C.T, missing Lambda or V, and all three state/adjoint-product directional terms. C-route uses repeated-slot w*a² source forcing and existing forward/adjoint rho equality only for real point sampling+complex-symmetric Ar. No conjugate Z in physical center.

affine_defects.C: F=Rhat_unique−[diag(w)*a*Zhat[source].T−JᵀD]; effective rV=rawrV+Qsrc Fᴴ. This includes the affine mismatch rather than accepting and ignoring it. Oracle rejects any unissued/tampered export before this computation.

cost_scope.included: Bound residual stencils, source/receiver injection columns, paid/missing residual columns, bound contractions, batched transform/solve dispatches and logical columns, all diagnostic column norms through ops.norm_columns, Frobenius defect norms, survey vector norms and directional dot products. Existing coarse receiver/source constants charge their own reduced RHS/eigen work.
cost_scope.excluded_from_query_delta: Current merit, approximate missing-field generation and full stability setup. These must be charged by the owning experiment and are explicitly false in result.costs. Proposal helper reports only norm-free query delta; owner charges constructor/prepare. No lower total-time claim follows from a smaller bound-query count.
cost_scope.units: Counters are executed work categories, not FLOPs. Batched legacy counts measure logical columns; dispatches remain separate. No online fine RHS/factorization is executed by this bound/helper.

failure_scope: Zero proposal/direction never establishes true stationarity. Unavailable context keeps descriptive physical proposal but aggregate bound/upper null; nonfinite arithmetic returns incomplete numeric abstention with strict-JSON null guards. Invalid owner/model/operator/data/shape is rejected. Pointwise negative upper derivative does not authorize clipped displacement or finite step; paid strict merit acceptance remains separate.
